name: 2048 Ventures
sectors: Vertical AI, deep tech, healthcare, and biotech
stage: Pre-seed and seed. The firm says it partners with founders at day zero and offers a dedicated Pre-Seed Fast Track.
check_size: $500K-$3M; the Pre-Seed Fast Track is for rounds of $500K-$1.5M
geography: Primarily New York City and Boston
best_channel: Use the direct Pitch Us form; the firm says no warm introduction is needed and every pitch is reviewed.
cold_pitch_policy: Direct pitches are welcome. The official site says founders do not need a warm introduction.
notes: Strong option for healthcare, biotech, deep-tech, or vertical-AI founders with a data moat. The firm says it can move from first meeting to a pre-seed lead decision in 10 business days.

name: Nina Capital
sectors: Healthcare transformation powered by data, computing, networks, and other digital, information, and deep technologies; excludes drugs and vaccines
stage: Pre-seed to seed+, with a preference for pre-seed and seed
geography: Europe, United Kingdom, United States, Canada, Israel, and Australia
best_channel: Send the pitch deck to dealflow@nina.capital or use the Pitch Us route on the contact page.
cold_pitch_policy: The official contact page openly publishes a deal-flow inbox for pitch decks.
notes: A healthcare-only investor for need-driven founders applying information technology and engineering across the care continuum. The firm can lead or co-invest.

name: Define Ventures AI Fellows Program
type: Equity-free founder program run by an early-stage health-tech VC
stage: Pre-idea and idea-stage founders are explicitly welcome
check_size: No investment and no equity exchanged; 10-week part-time program
geography: San Francisco-based founders; primarily virtual with in-person gatherings in San Francisco
best_channel: Apply through the linked Google Form; email karsten@definevc.com with questions.
cold_pitch_policy: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
notes: Useful before fundraising for healthcare-AI founders who need healthcare go-to-market guidance and access to senior industry operators. The program is not an investment.

name: Rock Health Capital
stage: Pre-seed, seed, and Series A; typically the first institutional round
geography: United States focus; no explicit restriction found
best_channel: Use the Rock Health contact page and select the capital/investment route.
cold_pitch_policy: Rock Health invites early-stage entrepreneurs who are raising capital to contact its investment team.
notes: Healthcare-only early-stage fund for technology-enabled solutions intended to make care more affordable, effective, or equitable.

name: MedTech Innovator
sectors: Medical devices, diagnostics, and digital health
stage: Pre-seed to Series C; technology readiness ranges from concept stage to approved and on market
check_size: Program resources and competition awards vary; no standard investment stated
best_channel: Apply through the official MedTech Innovator application portal when the annual window opens.
cold_pitch_policy: The 2027 cycle lists an application period from October through December 2026.
notes: Large medical-technology accelerator with mentoring, curriculum, industry visibility, and funding-resource access. Founders with applicable technology may apply before incorporation but must incorporate before the program begins.

name: SOSV SF / SOSV NY (formerly IndieBio)
type: Deep-tech and biotech accelerator with pre-seed investment
sectors: Human and planetary health, biotech, therapeutics, diagnostics, food, agriculture, chemistry, physics, AI, and deep tech
stage: Pre-seed; supports scientists launching startups and encourages early ideas to mature and reapply
check_size: $250K stated by the IndieBio program materials; verify current SOSV terms before accepting
geography: Global programs based in San Francisco and New York
best_channel: Submit the online application; applications are handled on a rolling basis with interview batches.
cold_pitch_policy: Open online application; re-applications and progress updates are encouraged.
notes: In 2026 the IndieBio locations were renamed SOSV SF and SOSV NY and expanded beyond biology while retaining the same teams, labs, and early-stage company-building model.

name: Osnabrueck Healthcare Accelerator (OHA)
sectors: Healthcare with a focus on digital health and medtech
stage: Pre-seed, seed, and early growth; incorporation is not required, but the solution must be more concrete than an idea on paper
check_size: Free six-month program; no investment stated
geography: Startups from across Germany; largely virtual or hybrid with occasional Osnabrueck attendance
best_channel: Apply through the official form and upload a pitch deck by October 4, 2026 at 23:59 GMT.
cold_pitch_policy: Open application window; OHA selects 5-6 companies after a pitch day.
notes: Free healthcare-specific support covering topics such as healthcare financing and medical-device certification. The current application window is open from April 27 through October 4, 2026.

name: Tenity Digital Health Accelerator Switzerland
check_size: Zero upfront fee; success fee only after a first financing, capped at CHF 100K of shares or 2% equity, whichever is better for the founder
geography: Zurich-based program with international EU travel reimbursement
best_channel: Use the Apply link on the official program page; 2027 applications are open and early submissions are encouraged.
cold_pitch_policy: Open application for the 2027 program; exact schedule is still to be announced.
notes: Four-month healthtech incubation with hospital, insurer, research, investor, mentorship, and proof-of-concept connections. Read the success-fee terms before joining.

name: DayOne Accelerator
sectors: Digital health, pharma-facing health technology, and medtech
stage: Idea stage through early-to-mid stage, depending on the selected vertical
geography: Digital Health Nation is Switzerland-focused; Health 4.0 accepts ventures worldwide; DayOne Tech is based in the canton of Jura
best_channel: Choose the relevant vertical on the official application page and submit its linked F6S form.
cold_pitch_policy: Open application links are published for all three verticals.
notes: Digital Health Nation explicitly helps bring a digital-health idea to life; Health 4.0 is international and pharma-facing; DayOne Tech supports medtech prototypes.

name: MATTER
sectors: Healthcare, life sciences, and health technology
stage: All stages; the free Flex membership is explicitly for idea-stage startups, innovators, and students
check_size: Flex membership is free; Select membership is $400 per month; no standard investment
geography: Global virtual community with facilities in Chicago
best_channel: Start with the free Flex option at idea stage; consider paid Select only if personalized support justifies the monthly cost.
cold_pitch_policy: Self-service registration is available for Flex; Select uses an application.
notes: MATTER is a support and network route, not a direct investment. Flex provides curriculum, a professional-services directory, a knowledge library, Expert Clinic Lite, and member Slack.

name: Health Wildcatters
sectors: Health tech, biotech, digital health, medical devices, diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, and healthcare services
check_size: $30K cash and program benefits for 8% equity; follow-on and convertible-note opportunities may bring total cash to as much as $380K
geography: Global applicants; hybrid program centered in Dallas, Texas
best_channel: Do not apply now; monitor the accelerator page for the next winter/spring application window.
cold_pitch_policy: The 2026 applications are closed. The site says applications are generally accepted in winter and spring for the fall program.
notes: Applications for the 2026 cohort are closed. Recurring annual accelerator for 8-12 healthcare startups, with a mentor and investor network and a September-to-November program.
